title: I found 3 things
in my GitHub
I can {{sell.}}
slides.body: Not a new app. Not a SaaS. Three things I already built, sitting in repos, one rename away from being products. Here they are.

title: The problem isn't
building. It's
{{shipping.}}
slides.body: Most of us have folders full of finished work nobody can buy. **The asset already exists.** The product is just packaging, a price, and a payment link.

slides.before: A script that builds my LinkedIn carousels from a text file.
slides.takeaway: A tool you use is a tool others will buy.

slides.before: An ebook reader app with one sample book in it.
slides.takeaway: Stop selling PDFs. Sell the experience.

slides.before: A video starter I cloned to learn from.
slides.takeaway: Sell your build, not the starter kit.

title: You don't need
a new idea.
You need to ship
the {{last one.}}
slides.body: Builder-brain says start over. The money says package what's already done and put a price on it today.

title: Steal the
{{system.}}
slides.body: This carousel was built with the kit that makes them — templates, the formula, the prompts, and one command. Buy it, run it, ship your own.
